transitions.historical_text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned while "Toon World" is on your side the field. Unless you pay 500 Life Points, this monster cannot attack. When "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, this card is also destroyed. If your opponent doesn't control a Toon Monster, this card can attack your opponent's Life Points directly. If a face-up Toon Monster is on your opponent's side of the field, you must select the Toon Monster as an attack target.

transitions.summary: Functional erratum: the clause requiring 'the same number of monsters needed for a Tribute Summon (normally 0)' was deleted, so the modern card is Special Summoned from the hand for free under all circumstances. The GOAT script still computes a Tribute cost from the card's current Level in its Special Summon procedure (2 above Level 6, 1 above Level 4 in spcon and above Level 5 in sptg, otherwise 0), so the historical card demands Tributes whenever an effect raises the printed Level 4 to 5 or higher; upstream's own two thresholds disagree by one Level, which is an upstream inconsistency, not a period rule.

rulings_check.difference: Era Toon Mermaid needs Tributes for its Special Summon from the hand if its Level in hand is raised to 5 or higher (script: 1 above Level 4 or 5, 2 above Level 6); the modern script demands none.

review.notes:
Baseline text is v1 (DB1-EN039, 2004-10-12), an exact match to the goat cdb entry, annotated 'Basically pre errata'; v0 (MRL-072, 2002-09-16) predates it and is not recorded. Card level confirmed as 4 from BabelCDB cards.cdb, so both recorded functional differences only bite in edge cases (an effect Summoning it outside a Special Summon, or an effect raising its Level in the hand) - they are still genuine script differences, not wording. No supported period snapshot falls after 2012-09-29, so the intermediate versions v3 and v4 need no historical implementation and none is claimed. Conflicting evidence preserved: the SS01 printing (v4) also drops the 'Cannot be Special Summoned unless you control a face-up "Toon World"' condition entirely, and v5 (SS04-ENB10, 2020-05-15) restores it as 'Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand), while you control "Toon World"'; neither upstream script ever drops the Toon World check (both gate the Special Summon procedure on it), so that transient text state is recorded here rather than as a behavioural change, and v4 -> v5 is otherwise cosmetic. Data anomaly: the packet's Retro Pack release events list tcg-na 2024-08-23 alongside tcg-eu 2008-07-08; the earliest_tcg_date the applier will copy (2008-07-08) is the sane one. Remaining script-diff hunk (RESETS_STANDARD_PHASE_END) is macro-equivalent.
